claim: The community magic file lists ten Shadow of War asset formats by magic: LTAR (arch06), BNDL, EMBB, LTFX (fxp), GADB (gamedb), LTMI (mat), MMSH (mesh), SCRI (scripts), SKEL and SKDB (strdb), each followed by a u32 version.
evidence: sow_magic defines string magics at offset 0 with a long version at offset 4 for each format.
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN - source does not state a game build; not checked against 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001
verification_method: Read the libmagic file and README in the clone. Against our build: once assets can be extracted, run a magic scan over extracted files and compare counts/versions.
limitations: These are loose-file formats inside archives; we cannot check them until archives are unpacked. Test fixtures in the repo (e.g. tests/gamedb/game.gamedb) are game-derived data and were not opened.
next_experiment: After an arch06 reader exists, confirm magic and version values per format on our build.
